post.description: Credits the wallet immediately and records a DEPOSIT transaction. Repeating a request with the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the original response without moving money again.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per wallet and request; 1-255 visible ASCII characters, e.g. a UUID.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when this is the stored response of an earlier identical request

post.description: Debits `amount` of fromCurrency and credits roundDown(amount × rate, 6) of toCurrency at the current rate (see GET /v1/fx/rates); the rate, its source and refresh time are recorded. Fails without changing anything if the balance does not cover the amount.

post.description: Debits `amount` of sourceCurrency from the sender and credits the receiver in destinationCurrency: the same amount when the currencies match (rate 1), otherwise roundDown(amount × rate, 6) at the current rate, which is recorded with its source.
